steps: Combine all three minces with the crushed garlic, bicarbonate, paprika, salt and pepper.
Work it by hand for ten minutes, adding the iced water a little at a time, until the mass turns tacky and even.
Press film onto the surface and refrigerate for at least twelve hours.
With wet hands roll sausages eight centimetres long and as thick as a thumb.
Grill over hot coals or on a griddle three minutes a side, turning once.
Split the warm somun, tuck the ćevapi inside and add a pile of raw onion and kajmak.
